LamBox.Empty:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Empty
      constructors:

Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Nat
      constructors:
        zero (0 arg(s))
        suc (1 arg(s))

Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Maybe
      constructors:
        just (1 arg(s))
        nothing (0 arg(s))

Agda.Builtin.Bool.Bool:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Bool
      constructors:
        false (0 arg(s))
        true (0 arg(s))

Prelude.if_then_else_:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ _ _ _ →
            case<Agda.Builtin.Bool.Bool{0},0> @2 of
              λ<[]> @0
              λ<[]> @1

Agda.Builtin.Nat._<_:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @0 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Bool.Bool{0}{0}
                   λ<[_]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @2 of
                       λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Bool.Bool{0}{1}
                       λ<[_]> @4 @0 @1

Prelude.max:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            Prelude.if_then_else_ □ □ (Agda.Builtin.Nat._<_ @1 @0) @0 @1

Agda.Builtin.List.List:
  mutual inductive(s):
    List
      constructors:
        [] (0 arg(s))
        _∷_ (2 arg(s))

Prelude.reverseAux:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @1 of
                   λ<[]> @0
                   λ<[_, _]> @6 □ □ @0 (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 @2)

Prelude.reverse:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ _ →
            Prelude.reverseAux □ □ @0 (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □)

Prelude.appendTR:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ _ _ →
            Prelude.reverseAux □ □ (Prelude.reverse □ □ @1) @0

Fannkuch.reversePrefixAux:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @2 of
                   λ<[]> Prelude.appendTR □ □ @0 @1
                   λ<[_]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @2 of
                       λ<[]> @1
                       λ<[_, _]> @6 @2 @0 (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 @3)

Fannkuch.reversePrefix:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            Fannkuch.reversePrefixAux @1 @0 (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □)

Fannkuch.flip:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ →
            case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @0 of
              λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
              λ<[_, _]>
                Fannkuch.reversePrefix (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} @1)
                  (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 @0)

Fannkuch.countFlipsAux:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @0 of
                   λ<[]> @1
                   λ<[_, _]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @1 of
                       λ<[]> @3
                       λ<[_]> @5 (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} @4) (Fannkuch.flip @3)

Fannkuch.countFlips:
  constant declaration:
    body: Fannkuch.countFlipsAux Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}

Prelude._×_:
  mutual inductive(s):
    _×_
      constructors: _,_ (2 arg(s))

Prelude._×_.fst:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ → case<Prelude._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @1

Prelude._×_.snd:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ → case<Prelude._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @0

Prelude.splitAt:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @1 of
                   λ<[]> Prelude._×_{0}{0} □ □ (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □) @0
                   λ<[_]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @1 of
                       λ<[]>
                         Prelude._×_{0}{0} □ □ (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □)
                           (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □)
                       λ<[_, _]>
                         λ _ _ _ _ _ _ →
                           case<Prelude._×_{0},2> @1 of
                             λ<[_, _]>
                               Prelude._×_{0}{0} □ □ (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @2 @1) @0
                           @6
                           @5
                           @2
                           @0
                           (@7 @6 □ @2 @0)
                           @1

Fannkuch.rotatePrefix:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @1 of
              λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
              λ<[_, _]>
                case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @2 of
                  λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 @0
                  λ<[_]>
                    case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @0 of
                      λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @2 @1
                      λ<[_]>
                        Prelude.appendTR □ □ (Prelude._×_.fst (Prelude.splitAt □ □ @1 @2))
                          (Prelude.appendTR □ □
                             (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @3
                                (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □))
                             (Prelude._×_.snd (Prelude.splitAt □ □ @1 @2)))

Fannkuch.resetCounts:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @1 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
                   λ<[_, _]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @2 of
                       λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 @0
                       λ<[_]>
                         Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}
                           (@5 @1 @0)

Prelude.updateAt:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @1 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
                   λ<[_, _]>
                     case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @2 of
                       λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ (@4 @1) @0
                       λ<[_]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @2 (@8 □ □ @5 @1 @0)

Prelude.findIndexAux:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @0 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0}{1} □
                   λ<[_, _]>
                     Prelude.if_then_else_ □ □ (@4 @3 @1)
                       (Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0}{0} □ @3)
                       (@7 □ □ @4 (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} @3) @0)

Fannkuch.nextPerm:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            λ _ _ _ →
              case<Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0},1> @1 of
                λ<[_]>
                  Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0}{0} □
                    (Prelude._×_{0}{0} □ □
                       (Fannkuch.rotatePrefix @1 (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} @0))
                       (Fannkuch.resetCounts
                          (Prelude.updateAt □ □ (λ _ → Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} @0) @3 @0)
                          @0))
                λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0}{1} □
              @0
              (Prelude.findIndexAux □ □ (λ _ _ → Agda.Builtin.Nat._<_ @0 @1)
                 Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}
                 @0)
              @1

Fannkuch.fannkuchLoop:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ →
                 @3 (Prelude.max @0 (Fannkuch.countFlips @2))
                   (Fannkuch.nextPerm @2 @1)
            1: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0},1> @0 of
                   λ<[_]> case<Prelude._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @6 @1 @0 @4
                   λ<[]> @1

Prelude.foldl:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.List.List{0},1> @0 of
                   λ<[]> @1
                   λ<[_, _]> @9 □ □ □ □ @4 (@4 @3 @1) @0

Prelude.rev:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            Prelude.foldl □ □ □ □
              (λ _ _ → Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @0 @1)
              (Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □)

Prelude.invrange:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @0 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
                   λ<[_]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @0 (@2 @0)

Prelude.range:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ → Prelude.rev □ □ (Prelude.invrange @0)

Prelude.replicate:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @1 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{0} □
                   λ<[_]> Agda.Builtin.List.List{0}{1} □ @1 (@5 □ □ @0 @1)

Fannkuch.fannkuch:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ →
            Fannkuch.fannkuchLoop (Prelude.range @0)
              (Prelude.replicate □ □ @0 Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0})
              Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}

Fannkuch.fannkuchBench:
  constant declaration: body: λ _ → Fannkuch.fannkuch @0

Fannkuch.test:
  constant declaration:
    body: Fannkuch.fannkuchBench
            (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1}
               (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1}
                  (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1}
                     (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1}
                        (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0})))))

Fannkuch.fannkuchLoopAux:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [1] :=
            0: λ _ _ _ →
                 @3 (Prelude.max @0 (Fannkuch.countFlips @2))
                   (Fannkuch.nextPerm @2 @1)
            1: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Maybe.Maybe{0},1> @0 of
                   λ<[_]> case<Prelude._×_{0},2> @0 of λ<[_, _]> @6 @1 @0 @4
                   λ<[]> @1

Prelude.findIndex:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ _ →
            Prelude.findIndexAux □ □ @0 Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}

Fannkuch.findI:
  constant declaration:
    body: Prelude.findIndex □ □ (λ _ _ → Agda.Builtin.Nat._<_ @0 @1)
main program: [Fannkuch.test]
